pages.home: Welcome to RegioSync - your platform for discovering local shops and regional producers. Use the top navigation to explore shops, view them on the map, or check pricing plans. Register as a Customer to browse and request products, or as a Seller to list your shop. Not logged in yet? Click Sign Up to create a free account in under a minute.
pages.shops: This page shows all registered local shops on the platform. Use the search bar at the top to filter shops by name, city, or description. Click on any shop card to open its detail page with all products, reviews, and contact info. Free accounts can browse up to 5 shops - upgrade to Pro to unlock unlimited access and advanced filters.
pages.shopDetail: You are viewing a single shop and all its available products. Click Request Product to send a message to the seller describing what you need - they will be notified immediately. Leave a star rating and written review to help other buyers. Pro users can click Get Directions to open a route directly to this shop's location in Google Maps.
pages.map: The regional map shows all registered shops as clickable markers. Click any marker to see the shop name and a quick link to its detail page. Use the zoom controls or scroll to explore. Free users see a limited map view without zoom or directions. Upgrade to Pro to unlock full zoom, your current GPS location, and turn-by-turn directions to any shop.
pages.pricing: Compare the Free and Pro plans side by side. Toggle between monthly and yearly billing - the yearly plan saves you 20%. The Pro plan unlocks unlimited shop browsing, full map access with zoom and directions, priority product requests, advanced search filters, and exclusive deals. Your current active plan is always visible in your Profile page.
pages.profile: This is your personal account page. Click Edit Profile to update your display name. Click the camera icon on your avatar to upload a new profile photo. Your current subscription plan (Free or Pro) is shown in the Subscription section. To upgrade to Pro, click the Upgrade button or visit the Pricing page. Your account email cannot be changed here - contact support for that.
pages.dashboard: This is your Seller Dashboard - your central hub for managing everything. The stat cards at the top show your total shops, products, average rating, and number of reviews. Click Create Shop to add a new listing. Use the edit and delete icons on each shop card to update or remove a shop. Incoming product requests from buyers are listed below, grouped by shop - accept or decline each request with one click.
pages.shopManage: Manage all products in this shop. Click Add Product to open the product form where you can enter a name, category, price, available quantity, optional image, and a discount percentage. Click the edit icon on an existing product to update its details. Setting quantity to 0 will mark the product as Unavailable - it stays listed but buyers cannot request it. Delete a product permanently using the trash icon.
pages.newShop: Create your new shop listing here. Enter a shop name and a short description that helps buyers understand what you sell. Type your street address in the address field - the city and map coordinates will be auto-filled. Alternatively click Use GPS to detect your current location automatically. Make sure your address is accurate so buyers can find you on the map. Click Create Shop when ready.
pages.notifications: This page shows all your notifications in real time. Unread notifications are highlighted with a blue left border. Click the checkmark icon to mark a single notification as read, or click Mark All as Read at the top to clear them all. Notifications are sent for new product requests from buyers, new reviews on your shop, and platform updates. New notifications also appear as a badge on the bell icon in the header.
pages.admin: This is the Admin Panel, accessible only to Super Admin accounts. The stats at the top give a platform-wide overview of total users, sellers, customers, and active accounts. Use the Users tab to view all registered accounts, change their role (User, Seller, Super Admin), or ban/unban them. Use the Reports tab to review flagged content and resolve moderation cases. All destructive actions require confirmation before being applied.
